mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, ba.bank_name, ba.account_name FROM fin_bank_reconcile r LEFT JOIN fin_bank_account ba ON r.bank_account_id = ba.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_bank_reconcile (bank_account_id, bank_trans_no, trans_date, trans_amount, summary, counter_party, status, cash_flow_id, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{bankAccountId}, #{bankTransNo}, #{transDate}, #{transAmount}, #{summary}, #{counterParty}, #{status}, #{cashFlowId}, #{createBy}, NOW())

mapper.select: WHERE r.bank_account_id = #{bankAccountId} AND r.status = '0' ORDER BY r.trans_date

SELECT cf.id AS cashFlowId, cf.bank_account_id AS bankAccountId, cf.direction, cf.amount, cf.flow_time AS flowTime, cf.biz_type AS bizType, cf.remark FROM fin_cash_flow cf WHERE cf.bank_account_id = #{bankAccountId} AND cf.id NOT IN (SELECT cash_flow_id FROM fin_bank_reconcile WHERE cash_flow_id IS NOT NULL AND bank_account_id = #{bankAccountId}) AND cf.flow_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY cf.flow_time

SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(trans_amount), 0) FROM fin_bank_reconcile WHERE bank_account_id = #{bankAccountId} AND status = '0') AS bankUnmatched, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fin_cash_flow WHERE bank_account_id = #{bankAccountId}) AS systemBalance
